tool_args.rationale: The pilot has only five short-horizon rows, whereas the target horizon is 20.3. Long-horizon observations are needed to identify slow adaptation and distinguish the recalled dual-horizon mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon law from pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify both timescales or determine long-horizon adaptation.
The short-window ambiguity concerns slow adaptation at the target horizon, which a long-horizon discriminating probe directly addresses.
It does not target the relevant mechanism or horizon.
